description: Explicit prepared join-plan reuse experiment on the unchanged 1000-row fixture. Historical scalar, PK and indexed_join schedules are preserved. Parameter cycles cover hits, misses, zero through many range rows, computed join bounds, LEFT join NULL extension, a PK-bound outer with at most 100 bucket matches, and a three-table fallback with all inputs PK-bound. Exact values, metadata and cost are checked through every public API and against the Rust Ruby binding. Physical-plan choice must remain parameter-sensitive.

workloads.name: pk_hit
workloads.sql: SELECT score FROM items WHERE id = $1

workloads.name: indexed_join
workloads.sql: SELECT a.label, b.score FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id AND b.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1

workloads.name: indexed_join_miss
workloads.sql: SELECT a.label, b.score FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id AND b.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1

workloads.name: indexed_join_range
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id AND b.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id < $1 ORDER BY a.id

workloads.name: indexed_join_computed_key
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id + 1 AND b.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 ORDER BY b.id

workloads.name: left_join_residual
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score FROM items a LEFT JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id AND b.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id

workloads.name: bucket_join
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.id, b.score FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.bucket = a.bucket AND b.score <> a.score WHERE a.id = $1 ORDER BY b.id

workloads.name: three_table_join
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 AND c.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id
